scenes.name: opening
scenes.prompt: An immense split pomegranate floats above an ink-blue ocean at night. Its cut half is very close along the left edge, a sweeping dark crimson rind curling overhead like a theatre balcony. Inside the fruit, luminous amber seeds are miniature windows and staircases. A wide opening between the seeds reveals a tiny bright golden city near the center-right. One long ivory staircase descends from the fruit toward the water, where the small city is reflected. A thin turquoise moon hangs far to the right. The fruit is cropped by the top and left edges; the distant city has clear breathing room. An exquisitely detailed surrealist oil painting, impossible scale and dream logic, luminous jewel-colored enamel and deep velvet shadows. Monumental readable silhouettes, delicate engraved textures and sharp reflected highlights. Broad cinematic composition with dramatic near and far forms. Rich colors remain separated by dark negative space.

Close curved golden towers frame the edges, leaving open space ahead.
